subject: Amendment required for draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference, and found a few discrepancies that need to be corrected.

For the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading currently shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

For the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading currently shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Thank you for your assistance.

Shipping Operations
